name: What does sub-trade coordination for electrical work involve during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: What does sub-trade coordination for electrical work involve during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: When taking on a kitchen, bathroom, or basement remodel, electrical sub-trade coordination means your general contractor schedules, manages, and oversees licensed electrical specialists alongside the rest of the build. At HH Remodeling LLC, owner Abraham Becerra serves as your single point of contact on-site. While our in-house crew focuses on framing, drywall, tile, and trim, we schedule the electrician at the exact phases required—such as rough-in wiring right after framing and before drywall installation. This keeps trades from getting in each other's way and prevents project stalls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Electrical coordination means your general contractor manages and schedules licensed electricians alongside framing, drywall, and finish trades on-site.
